card.name: Linking words before a named drug
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'as', 'of', 'including' or 'e.g.,' right before a specific drug name, mostly benzodiazepines and beta-blockers. Also fires on the start of propranolol and Valium.

modes.label: Link before drug example
modes.description: 'such as', 'including' or 'e.g.,' introducing a named drug from a class list.

modes.label: 'of' before a drug
modes.description: The word 'of' after dose reduction or withdrawal, just before the drug name.
modes.example: Abrupt discontinuation or rapid dosage reduction<< of>> triazolam after continued use may

modes.label: Start of a drug name
modes.description: The first piece of a drug name such as propranolol or Valium.

card.writes: It pushes toward drug-name beginnings like 'pro', 'proton' and 'neut', so the model expects a drug name next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a specific drug name is given, especially sedatives and beta-blockers.
